title: AI Operations Cockpit
description: A high-density enterprise AI workspace with a compact navigation rail, task-aware secondary panel, evidence-first canvas, and restrained telemetry.

direction.layout: 52px icon rail, 232px contextual panel, fluid work canvas, optional evidence drawer
direction.visual: cool gray canvas, ink typography, muted indigo accent, hairline dividers, low elevation
direction.motion: panel reveal and status transitions at 180–240ms; no ambient motion
direction.interaction: command palette, collapsible context panel, persistent composer, keyboard-first actions
direction.responsive: collapse context before the primary rail; move evidence into a sheet
direction.avoid: oversized metrics, decorative gradients, card grids for every section

title: Calm Enterprise Chat
description: A conversation-centered SaaS workspace with compact history, clear source provenance, comfortable messages, and a tool-enabled composer.

direction.layout: slim product rail, collapsible history, centered 760px message column, anchored composer
direction.visual: soft gray background, white canvas, graphite text, low-saturation blue-violet actions
direction.motion: message arrival uses opacity and a 6px rise; drawers use shared 200ms easing
direction.interaction: searchable history, hover actions, citations, attachments, and tool affordances
direction.responsive: history becomes an overlay; composer keeps attachment and send controls reachable
direction.avoid: large empty hero space, speech bubbles for every AI paragraph, dominant status bars

title: Data Story Dashboard
description: An operational dashboard pairing a narrative decision strip with compact charts, exceptions, and drill-down tables.

direction.layout: decision summary band, two-column analytical body, full-width exception table
direction.visual: warm white canvas, charcoal text, one cobalt signal color, tabular numerals
direction.motion: animate state changes only; charts respect reduced motion
direction.interaction: cross-filter chips, inline comparison, sticky table headers, visible data freshness
direction.responsive: stack narrative before charts and turn the table into prioritized records
direction.avoid: rainbow charts, unlabeled trends, equal KPI cards without hierarchy

title: Soft Tool Workspace
description: A focused productivity surface with calm navigation, direct manipulation, and a flexible document canvas.

direction.layout: compact sidebar, contextual header, edge-to-edge canvas with a readable inner measure
direction.visual: neutral surfaces, one saturated accent, crisp icons, subtle selected states
direction.motion: direct manipulation feedback at 120–180ms; gentle layout easing
direction.interaction: inline editing, slash actions, contextual menus, persistent save state
direction.responsive: sidebar becomes a drawer while the editing surface remains primary
direction.avoid: nested bordered cards, oversized page titles, a modal for every edit

title: Editorial Product Story
description: A product narrative with asymmetric editorial rhythm, proof-led sections, and precise typographic contrast.

direction.layout: off-center hero, alternating proof modules, editorial pull quotes, compact final CTA
direction.visual: cream ground, near-black type, mineral accent, controlled display typography
direction.motion: reveals preserve reading order; image masks open once and remain stable
direction.interaction: sticky section index, progressive detail, transparent CTA hierarchy
direction.responsive: retain typographic contrast while removing decorative offsets
direction.avoid: generic centered hero, repeating three-card rows, testimonial carousels

title: Cinematic Product Launch
description: A controlled launch page built around one visual object, progressive reveals, and a decisive conversion path.

direction.layout: full-bleed opening scene, object-led chapters, specification rail, short purchase close
direction.visual: dark field, luminous product edge, restrained chroma, precise technical labels
direction.motion: one coordinated timeline; provide static reduced-motion states
direction.interaction: chapter scrubber, specification hotspots, visible skip controls
direction.responsive: swap expensive scenes for composed stills and preserve the purchase path

title: Tactile Commerce
description: A product-first commerce experience with material detail, clear variants, confident pricing, and responsive purchase feedback.

direction.layout: immersive gallery, sticky decision panel, reassurance strip, related edit
direction.visual: material-aware imagery, warm neutrals, high-contrast price and primary action
direction.motion: variant changes crossfade quickly; cart feedback is immediate and reversible
direction.interaction: keyboard gallery, clear stock state, size guidance, persistent mobile purchase bar
direction.responsive: keep price, stock, and CTA within one mobile viewport
direction.avoid: hidden costs, auto-advancing gallery, low-contrast availability

title: Spatial Portfolio
description: A creative portfolio with layered project planes, generous typography, and discoverable navigation.

direction.layout: project index as anchor, layered feature planes, concise case-study chapters
direction.visual: monochrome base, project-specific accent, editorial type, deliberate image cropping
direction.motion: subtle depth and parallax; navigation has a non-animated equivalent
direction.interaction: project peek, keyboard navigation, persistent index and contact route
direction.responsive: flatten layers into a chronological sequence on small screens
direction.avoid: cursor gimmicks, illegible vertical text, mystery navigation
